description: Land Acquisition - Mahaiyawa, Kandy Four Gravets & Gangawata Korale D/S Division, Kandy District
categorisation: This gazette notice is a land acquisition notice published under the Land Acquisition Act, specifically detailing the government's intention to acquire specific land lots (Lots 1-3) for a public purpose. It contains detailed descriptions of the lands, including lot numbers, assessments, physical features, claimants, and extents. The content is exclusively focused on land and property-related matters, falling squarely under the Land Gazettes classification (Type 4).
